data.message: All my tasks are done, Eve! Let's head to cafeteria.

I called the emergency button because I wanted to check in, and it looks like Alice and Charlie are dead! I have some crucial information for everyone. 

My route was: upper engine -> oxygen -> upper engine -> medbay -> electrical -> security -> weapons -> cafeteria. 

Here are my exact encounters:
Early on, I saw Frank in oxygen and upper engine (around ticks 5-9). 
Then, I passed through Medbay and saw Charlie alive there at tick 12, and Alice alive there at tick 14. 
Later, I saw Diana on the right side of the map (she came from Nav to Security, then Weapons, and we ended up in Cafeteria together at the end).

If Alice died in Medbay and Charlie died in Storage, they had to have been killed after tick 14 since I saw them both alive in Medbay right before I headed to the right side of the ship. Diana is pretty cleared for me since she was on the right side of the map with me during the second half of the round. 

Bob and Frank, we need your exact routes. Which one of you was near Medbay or Storage after tick 14?

Eve, your timeline for Diana completely contradicts what I actually saw. 

My route was: Cafeteria -> Oxygen -> Upper Engine -> Lower Engine -> Storage -> Medbay -> Electrical -> Security.

You're right that we saw each other early in Oxygen around ticks 5 and 6. But I definitely saw Diana on the left side of the map, not the right. I was with Diana in Upper Engine at tick 8, and then again in Lower Engine at ticks 12 and 13. At tick 14, I literally watched Diana leave Lower Engine and head directly into Storage.

If Charlie died in Storage, Diana heading in there at tick 14 makes her our prime suspect. Eve, I don't know how you could have seen her coming from Nav to Security if she was in Lower Engine with me right before the halfway point of the round. 

Bob, we really need to hear your route to piece the rest of this together. Diana, you have some serious explaining to do about heading into Storage.

Okay everyone, I have important info. My route was: electrical -> medbay -> cafeteria -> weapons -> security -> navigation -> storage -> lower engine -> back to storage -> medbay -> electrical -> medbay.

Critical point: I saw Charlie ALIVE in storage at tick 24. I actually watched him enter storage from lower engine around tick 22-24. So Charlie was definitely alive at tick 24 — that means whoever Frank saw enter Storage at tick 14 (Diana, by his account) didn't necessarily do it then, OR Diana came back later. Either way, the kill window on Charlie is AFTER tick 24, not after tick 14.

And here's the big one — I just walked back into medbay and Alice's body is right here next to me. I saw Alice alive in medbay at tick 29. That's one tick before this meeting was called. So Alice was killed VERY recently, basically as Eve was hitting the button from cafeteria.

Now let's line things up. Eve, you say Diana was with you on the right side — Nav, Security, Weapons, Cafeteria. Frank, you say Diana was with you in Lower Engine through tick 13 and then walked into Storage at tick 14. Those two stories cannot both be true. One of you is lying about Diana.

Frank's story is more specific and it puts Diana in Storage — where Charlie ended up dead. Eve, are you sure it was Diana you were with on the right side, or could you be covering for someone? Because if Frank is telling the truth, Diana walking into Storage right before Charlie's death window is the most suspicious movement we've heard. Diana, I want to hear your route — and Eve, I want you to think hard about whether you actually saw Diana the whole second half, or just assumed.

Bob, you've just made a fatal mistake. You tried to create a contradiction where there isn't one, and you basically confessed to Alice's murder. 

Both Eve and Frank are telling the EXACT truth about my movements. My actual route was: Medbay -> Upper Engine -> Lower Engine -> Storage -> Navigation -> Security -> Weapons. 

Frank, you were absolutely right. I was with you in Lower Engine from ticks 12 to 14, and then I went into Storage. But I didn't stay there! I kept moving across the bottom of the map through Navigation, up to Security, and then to Weapons, which is exactly where Eve saw me from ticks 26 to 28. 

Bob, you tried to pit Frank and Eve against each other by claiming it's "impossible" for both of their stories to be true. It's completely possible—it's literally just me crossing the map. You made up that contradiction to frame me and cast doubt on the only two players who actually saw me. 

On top of that, you just admitted to being alone in Medbay with Alice at tick 29, right before Eve called the meeting, and you claim her body is right next to you. You killed Alice right before the bell! 

Everyone, Bob is the Duck. He killed Alice, and he's lying to manipulate the timeline. We vote Bob right now.

Diana is absolutely right, and my own direct observations prove it. Bob, you tried to claim that Frank's story and my story about Diana contradict each other, but they actually line up perfectly. I literally saw Diana enter Security coming from Navigation at tick 21! That bridges the gap perfectly between Frank seeing her head into Storage at tick 14 and me seeing her on the right side of the map later on. 

You fabricated a fake contradiction to frame Diana. Add that to the fact that you just admitted to being the last person with Charlie in Storage around tick 24, AND you admitted to being alone with Alice in Medbay at tick 29 right before I hit the button? You just confessed to both murders while trying to play us against each other. 

Bob is 100% the Duck. We all need to vote Bob right now.

Diana and Eve, you both make excellent points. I completely missed that Diana could have just kept moving across the map—my apologies for assuming a contradiction earlier! Since Diana's travel time from Storage to Navigation to Security perfectly bridges the gap between my sighting of her at tick 14 and Eve's sighting later on, her timeline is absolutely solid. 

Bob, you really dug your own grave here. You tried to force a contradiction between Eve and me to frame Diana, but you only ended up proving that you were desperate to deflect attention. Worse, you freely admitted to being the last person with Charlie in Storage at tick 24, AND you admitted to standing right next to Alice in Medbay at tick 29, the very moment before the meeting was called. 

There's only one Duck in this game, and with Diana and Eve's timelines perfectly corroborating each other—and matching my own observations—it's mathematically impossible for anyone but Bob to be the Duck. 

I'm locking in my vote for Bob. Let's get him out of here and win this.

Look, I hear you all, but you're rushing to a conclusion based on a story that just happens to line up TOO perfectly. Diana, you conveniently match both Frank's AND Eve's sightings only AFTER they each spoke and gave you the exact windows you needed to thread. That's suspicious in itself.

But fine — let's talk about me. Yes, I was in Storage around when Charlie was there, and yes, I just walked into Medbay and found Alice's body. I'm telling you that openly because I'm not the Duck. If I killed Alice, why would I sit on the body? I'd have walked out and let someone else find her. I came back to Medbay to finish a task, and Alice was already dead when I arrived this tick — Eve hit the button basically the same moment.

And on Charlie — I saw him alive in Storage at tick 24, then I left for lower engine and came back through. Plenty of time for someone else to hit him. Frank, you literally said your route ended Storage -> Medbay -> Electrical -> Security. You were in Storage too. Why is no one asking about that?

I know the room is against me. But if you vote me and I'm wrong, you've handed the Duck the game. Think hard before you lock it in.

Bob, your defense makes zero sense. You say "if I killed Alice, why would I sit on the body?" — you didn't have a choice! Eve called the emergency meeting at tick 30. You literally just killed her at tick 29 and got caught by the bell before you could even leave the room. 

And as for my timeline being "too perfect," it's perfect because it's the truth. Frank and Eve both saw me at different points of my exact route across the map. Meanwhile, you have conveniently placed yourself as the last person to see Charlie in Storage (tick 24) AND the last person to see Alice in Medbay (tick 29). You are the only one who fits the timeline for both kills. 

Eve and Frank, we have this 100% locked down. Don't let him sow any last-minute doubt. We vote Bob right now and win this game.

Bob
